qs.q: A community health nurse is designing a municipal strategy centered around health education, vaccination campaigns, and early screening. Which tier of the healthcare delivery system does this intervention primarily represent?
qs.e: Primary care is primarily focused on preventive measures and early health maintenance. Secondary care is directed more toward treating acute manifestations and established diseases.
